newsitem.title: CANADA: CMHC sets C$65 mln bond due 2001 at 99.249.
newsitem.headline: CMHC sets C$65 mln bond due 2001 at 99.249.

text.p: Canadian Mortgage and Housing Corporation, a federally guaranteed issuing agency, issued on Monday a C$65 million 6.25 percent bond due September 4, 2001 at a retail price of C$99.249, lead manager RBC Dominion Securities Inc said.
RBC Securities said the issue was set with a yield to investors of 6.426 percent on a monthly basis and 6.513 percent on a semi-annual basis.
The issue was priced to yield less than the Government of Canada 7.0 percent bond due 2001, said Coleen Miller, deputy treasury with CMHC.
The issue will be delivered on September 4, 1996, RBC Dominion said.
